releases.notes:
- Now on NeoForge and Forge too, and on Minecraft 1.18.2 up to 26.3
- WaveyCapes support for banner capes
- Curios support: banners in the back and head slots
- Banners fit in the helmet slot on older versions too
- Fixed banners in Trinkets and Accessories slots not showing
- Fixed horse, boat, raft and villager banners on older versions
- The mod is now under the tr7zw Protective License
